metric: basis: cure output inside the plant month, opening stock INCLUDED, carry-out tail EXCLUDED
of which OPENING STOCK carried in
of which BUILT after month end (carry-out)
A  BUILT this month, sheet 1 + sheet 5 + sheet 7 'built'
B  + OPENING GT STOCK consumed (on the floor at 07:00 day 1)
C  - GT still unbuilt-into-cure at month end (closing stock -> next month's opening)
D  = TYRES CURED IN-MONTH (A+B-C) = sheet 2 'qty' = sheet 7 'cured' = fulfilment numerator
E  + press slots planned but NEVER FED (starved presses)
F  = CAMPAIGN NAMEPLATE (sheet 2b 'qty_planned', sheet 6 'tyres_planned') = D + C + E
F is PRESS CAPACITY SEATED, not tyres. Never quote it as output.
